subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, ever if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**statements :**

some pens are books.

All books are compasses.

Some compasses are pins.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some compasses are pens.

II. All compasses are pens.

III. Some pins are books.

IV. Some compasses are books.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and IV follow
Only conclusions III and IV follow

solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

Conclusions :

I. Some compasses are pens → Follow [As some pens are books and All books are compasses. So some compasses are pens is definitely followed.]

II. All compasses are pens →Does not follow [As some pens are books and All books are compasses. All compasses are pens is possible but not definitely followed.]

III. Some pins are books →Does not follow [ As no definite relation given between pins and books, so it can be possible only]

IV. Some compasses are books → Follow [As some pens are books and All books are compasses. Some compasses are books is definitely followed.]

So, Only conclusions I and IV follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
